description.value:
You swim through groups like water.

When you are in or adjacent to a friendly crowd or allied group (at least three non-hostile creatures within 2 squares of you):

  • You gain the benefits of half cover (+2 Guard and Intrigue checks) against ranged attacks and effects coming from outside the crowd.
  • Allies adjacent to you gain a +1 bonus to Guard as long as you maintain this flow and do not become Staggered.

You may treat maintaining Crowd Current as a light Clarity hold-like state; the GM may rule that you lose its benefits if you are stunned, knocked prone repeatedly, or otherwise disrupted.

system.requirements: Dreamwalker 6, Trance of the Thousand Faces
